import json, pathlib, urllib.request
from smolagents import CodeAgent, tool
from smolagents.models import Model, ChatMessage, MessageRole

class PollinationsLegacyModel(Model):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(model_id="pollinations-openai-fast")
    def generate(self, messages, stop_sequences=None, **kwargs):
        flat=[]
        for m in messages:
            role=getattr(m,"role","user")
            role=getattr(role,"value",role)
            c=getattr(m,"content","")
            if isinstance(c,list):
                parts=[]
                for x in c:
                    if isinstance(x,dict):
                        parts.append(str(x.get("text") or x.get("content") or x))
                    else:
                        parts.append(str(x))
                c="\n".join(parts)
            flat.append({"role":str(role),"content":str(c)})
        body=json.dumps({"messages":flat,"model":"openai-fast"}).encode()
        req=urllib.request.Request("https://text.pollinations.ai/",data=body,headers={"Content-Type":"application/json","User-Agent":"ProjectBrain/1.0"},method="POST")
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as r:
            text=r.read(50000).decode("utf-8","replace")
        return ChatMessage(role=MessageRole.ASSISTANT, content=text)

@tool
def read_canonical_generation() -> str:
    """Read and return the canonical_generation value from Project Brain's canonical pointer."""
    x=json.loads(pathlib.Path("canonical/CANONICAL_POINTER.json").read_text())
    return x["canonical_generation"]

    tools=[read_canonical_generation],

)

))

print("EXPECTED="+expected)
if expected not in result:
    raise SystemExit("SMOLAGENTS_TOOL_LOOP_FAILED")
